text: {"claims":[{"quote":"the freshest read was for fiscal 2024, which ended December 28, 2024","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"Disney\u2019s revenue reached $237.2 billion, up 15% from $204.7 billion in fiscal 2023 and versus $179.5 billion in fiscal 2022.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"Net income increased to about $11.2 billion from $8.2 billion in fiscal 2023","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"diluted EPS was $1.39, or $1.51 on an adjusted basis.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"Operating margin was thin, around 5%, with net margin near 5%.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"Cash flow from operations was about $24.2 billion, and free cash flow was roughly $18 billion.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"The prior fiscal year, 2023, generated revenue of $204.7 billion, net income of $8.2 billion, EPS of $1.25, and operating cash flow of about $21.8 billion.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"Fiscal 2022 produced revenue of $179.5 billion, net income of $5.3 billion, and EPS of $0.67 as the pandemic recovery began.","verdict":"wrong"},{"quote":"Across FY2022-FY2024, Disney showed a rebound in revenue and earnings, but profitability and streaming economics lagged pre-pandemic levels.","verdict":"unchecked"},{"quote":"The stock as of the 2025-03-31 update appeared to offer a contrarian recovery play, though execution and margin risks persisted.","verdict":"unchecked"}],"action":"block"}
